rationale: The question asks which ATT&CK techniques CAPEC-639 maps to and what mitigations apply to those techniques. The gold requires 5 mapped techniques (T1039, T1552.001, T1552.003, T1552.004, T1552.006) and 8 ATT&CK mitigations (M1015, M1017, M1022, M1027, M1028, M1041, M1047, M1051). The answer surfaces none of these -- it only reports CAPEC-639's Status/Abstraction properties and its single CAPEC-level mitigation (capec:attack-pattern:639:mitigation:1), which is not what was asked. Notably, the evidence itself proves the mapped techniques exist and were reachable: CAPEC-639's facets show 'MAPS_TO' -> TaxonomyEntry with count=5 (matching the gold's 5 techniques exactly), but sub-question q4 ('list all TaxonomyEntry reached from CAPEC-639 via MAPS_TO') used the 'describe' template and returned an empty 'related' list instead of enumerating the 5 TaxonomyEntry nodes, so the technique IDs were never captured. Because q1/q4 failed to produce technique IDs, the downstream ATT&CK mitigation sub-question (q2) had no seed and was skipped entirely (attack: 0 of 5 required records, 0 of 8 required mitigations). Everything the answer does state (the CAPEC-639 properties and its CAPEC mitigation) is faithfully grounded in the retrieved records with no invented facts, so faithfulness/groundedness are high, but the answer fails to address the actual question and is missing 13 of 14 gold-required identifiers, warranting an INCORRECT verdict rather than a partial credit for an unrelated-but-accurate detail.
